# Native

> Native is a clean, simple, and effective personal care brand specializing in aluminum-free deodorant, natural body care, and eco-conscious grooming products.

Native offers a comprehensive range of natural personal care products including deodorant, body wash, hair care, and skincare with vegan, cruelty-free formulations. The brand emphasizes hypoallergenic options and limited-edition fragrance collections inspired by global flavors and seasonal themes.

## Key Topics

- Deodorant
- Aluminum-free
- Natural Personal Care
- Body Wash
- Fragrance Collections
- Vegan & Cruelty-free
- Sensitive Series

- Body Care

- Rewards Program
- Sustainable Products
